<!-- pr126-old-published-braid-disposition-20261006 -->

Closing without merging as **already_solved, scoped to mathematical content already implied by published results**. The first explicit application to Wajnryb's named question remains unestablished.

The submitted narrow theorem is mathematically correct: three distinct, pairwise noncommuting Anosov diffeomorphisms of the closed torus satisfy all three length-three braid relations as actual maps. The source explicitly permits this torus case. Fresh independent mathematical and source reviews pass, and the normal-mode 311 author and 3,156 independent checks reproduce.

The priority issue is the pair-to-triple step. [Birman–Ko–Lee1998](https://www.math.columbia.edu/~jb/bkl-newpres.pdf), Eq.(4), p.325, and Proposition2.1, Eq.(8), p.327, publish the band-generator identities giving c=aba^-1 and ab=ca=bc. These imply all three braid relations in any group image; cancellation establishes distinctness and conjugacy preserves the Anosov property. No faithful representation is required. [Wajnryb's source](https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~farb/papers/mcgbook.pdf), Section2, manuscript p.124/PDF131, already credits the referee with the initial Anosov pair mechanism, which the submitted matrices instantiate. Together, these published ingredients yield the whole claimed existential theorem.

The explicit matrices and verification can have expository value, but no substantive additional theorem is established here. The PR does not prove a faithful triangular Artin embedding, an independent third generator, or a construction for every prescribed higher genus.

We did not locate an earlier paper expressly announcing the answer to this exact named question; this disposition therefore makes no claim about its historical first solver or the first appearance of these exact matrices. The category concerns the verified old-content implication.

A repairable optimized-execution weakness in the independent verifier was identified and a narrow guard repair tested in isolated audit copies; it does not invalidate the written proof or normal reproduction. The original submitted effort remains1/5, with0 additional proof-search turns. The valid proof and detailed audits will be retained. No novel-resolution preprint, Zenodo DOI or tracker row is being created for this PR.
